262.synopsis:
A world where swords, bows, and magic flutter about.
Amagi Shigehisa, who was taking his university entrance exams, suddenly transferred into such a world without any warning.
As the strongest race, Dragunir.
Who and for what purpose? Without harboring this question for long, Shigehisa confronts an excessively heartless and harsh reality.
Shigehisa transferred into the North Tenshia Continent.
There, with the exception of humans, the Beast people like the Wolfmen tribe, Tigermen tribe, and others, experience extreme discrimination and oppression, and are forced into a life-threatening lifestyle every day.
Thus, Shigehisa made a decision.
“By my own means, I will make a kingdom for the sake of fluffiness!”
Because of a man who possesses a lifespan and power unmatched by humans, a battle which involves the whole continent starts.
Shigehisa, revising his name to “Georg Stanford”, the protagonist in a RPG he played during his high school days, brings together the beast people from every place in the continent.
associated_names: The Records of Kingdom of Galdina's Rise to Power
ガルディナ王国興国記

518.synopsis:
Slava is an old man. On the verge of death, he has only two regrets; not perfecting his Martial Arts that had been passed down by his Master, and leaving his adopted daughter, as well as disciple, the Elf Alma, alone. His two dying wishes that he makes to her are that she take the hidden scroll of the school and learn its secrets, and that she would love, have a family, and be happy in his stead.
But Slava is reborn as an Elf, and with the same first name too! Being told that he was named after the only master of “Alma-sama”, it appears that some time had passed and his adopted daughter had become a very important person!
associated_names: Dedicated Himself into Martial Art for Over 100 Years. Restarting Martial Art Pilgrimage as an Elf
武に身を捧げて百と余年。エルフでやり直す武者修行

1542.synopsis:
Tokyo Swordia, formerly known as Tokyo Metropolitan, has been ruled by the “Swordies” since the Third World War 70 years ago. These Swordies, natural-born swordswomen with an attraction to blades, more or less rule the country, and are considered upper-class members of society.
In order to raise his own social status, Kurou, a human, begins attending an academy of swordsmanship, surrounding himself with Swordies on a daily basis. How will he fare in combat against those born to fight?

2310.synopsis:
There are always moments far in the past that remain forever engraved in our memory. The last decade of the 20th century was chock full of unique memories – memories of The Little Tigers, The Bund, and the Four Heavenly Kings that brought us great emotions now rest with the dust-covered journals of our youth.
Born in the 80’s, Tong Hua has brought together a classic youth book that reminds readers that those timeless memories of our youth are only so precious due to their brief nature. Bring those memories back once again with this memorable read; though we are gradually aging and leaving our past behind, our warm, child-like spirits will never fade!
associated_names: 那些回不去的年少时光

6150.synopsis:
Youth, is meant to be used to shed sweat under the sun!
Youth, is to continuously engage in battles, and secure the win! The endless journey on Heaven’s Road, an endless expedition, a testimony of a hot-blooded youth’s legend!
A dream every man harbors, with the ignition of the blood! Forever young, Undefeated God of War!
associated_names: ยอดยุทธไร้เทียมทาน

7174.synopsis: He was strong. With a handsome appearance, he was even stronger than his father, the one who was called the strongest. The student enjoyed his youth inside his High School. However, because he was on really good terms with the three major goddesses of the campus, he concealed his strength. Because of other’s jealousy, he was bullied daily. One day, Tetsuya was summoned with his classroom into another world. Although he should have earned a cheat ability, he received nothing. His status was even below the average villager! But with no ability and a weak status, how much could be done, even by a genius? Thus, he got bullied and dropped inside a Dungeon. But his true abilities awakened inside the Dungeon! The epic tale of the traveler begins now!
associated_names: Heroic Tale of the Emperor God Hero’s 《Ryokou Tan》
神皇勇者の英雄譚《りょこうたん》

7686.synopsis:
The day prior to female otaku Hayakawa Ryouko’s 35th birthday, she departed the world in a traffic accident. As she opened her eyes again, she was reincarnated into a beautiful blonde-haired prince of a great kingdom in a fantasy world.
In that great kingdom… In Greisis kingdom, there’s a king despised by his retainers, tyrant nobles, corrupt officials, and so on… It’s in a precarious situation.
For the sake of protecting his father and family, as well as helping the citizens, the reincarnated Prince Herscherik is determined to fight.
Making use of his skill as an office clerk in the past, being full of initiative in his nature along with his (otaku-ish) intellect, the reincarnated prince faces many kinds of incidents.
Books in this series:
I. Reincarnated Prince and the Kingdom of Sorrow
II. Reincarnated Prince and the Knight of Twilight
III. Reincarnated Prince and the Magus of White Rainbow
IV. Reincarnated Prince and the Hero of Light
V. Reincarnated Prince and the Pride of Warring Kingdom
VI. Reincarnated Prince Series: Short Story Collection
VII. Reincarnated Prince and the Divine Priest of the Land of the Sun

ハーシェリク（転生王子シリーズ）
転生王子と憂いの大国
転生王子と白虹の賢者
転生王子と軍国の至宝
転生王子と陽国の神子姫
転生王子と黄昏の騎士
転生王子シリーズ　短編集

9734.synopsis:
The happiest thing in the world is to be able to amend what you have done wrong. She who acted willfully because of a game, was reincarnated into a time when she still had her parents’ love.
For the sake of her family, she began her life as a pro gamer.
But this time, she was no longer the Human Sorceress that she was familiar with. She was an Elven Huntress. Could she still acquire the power to be the Right Hand of God?

11014.synopsis: Endless sky and infinite space, the cosmos isn’t some paradise waiting to be found, it is full of darkness and danger, death and terror of the great unknown. However, for that glittering swath of blue, we have no fear! For the longevity of men, we have no regrets! Nothing shall stand in our way because it is finally our time, our age! The age of cosmos exploration!

12038.synopsis:
The MC entered the body of the An family eldest son, An Ziran, an arrogant 16 years old boy who weighed 78 kg (~171-172 lbs), who only knew how to eat, play and sleep. Seeing his current body, An Ziran decided his first priority was to LOSE WEIGHT!
Three days later after he became An Ziran, An Ziran’s father and his biological mother died, which meant as the eldest son he had to take over the family business.
Beside his legitimate first wife, An Ziran’s father also married 3 other women, who all wanted to take over the An family fortune but only the eldest son could be able to touch it, therefore they have to depend on An Ziran in order to live a comfortable life.
An Ziran’s father also had an older brother who is always planning to steal the An family fortune. The elder brother of An Ziran’s father and the woman he married had powerful connections. In order to save the An family fortune, An Ziran has to find a golden thigh to cling on. The butler told An Ziran that there is an engagement between the An family and an influential family. Therefore he takes his sister to that family house to make a connection.
However, during their journey, An Ziran’s younger sister overheard that the son of that family is UGLY, so as a beautiful and spoiled young lady coming from a rich household, she didn’t want to marry him and decided to run away. Without any other choice, An Ziran had to take his sister’s​ place and marry that man, who told him that he would let him go soon, but lied.
associated_names: อันจื่อหราน คหบดีอันดับหนึ่ง

12294.synopsis:
“This child will destroy her father.”
The fourth empress was married to Emperor Wolfgang of the Heinzel Empire, who had killed the three previous empresses and was called the Brutal Emperor. Her name was Nicolette. It was the first time Wolfgang had heard the name, but she was the second princess of Royalty Kingdom. However, she had been confined to the monastery by her father, the king. The princess who had received the prophecy of killing her father.
Wolfgang, who was said to be brutal, was healed by the cheerful Nicolette, although she was a bit different from the world’s norms.
The emperor who was said to be atrocious, and the princess who received the prophecy of killing her father went round. Will that prophecy be reality?
associated_names: The Cruel Emperor and the Queen of Prophecy
残虐皇帝と予言の王女【連載版】

12806.synopsis:
Dreams are the visualization of desire – a doorway that can lead to the depths of a person’s heart; it can embody their deepest yearning,  to such a degree that the consciousness and experience of incalculable ancestors can be passed on. In the vast boundless universe, there exists such a people. They can enter dreams, explore it, change it, use it, and manipulate it. They call themselves Watchmen.
At only the age of sixteen, Jiu Jie encountered an unforeseen event. Since then, he became one of them, a Watchman – to set foot and explore dreams riddled in the mysteries of no return. But in the wake of manipulating dreams, as his abilities continued to grow, a world-shaking secret began to emerge.

13318.synopsis:
It was at the shoe rack, a letter.
That thing was what changed the relationship between these two girl friends. Transforming their feelings for each other. A girl’s love story from both perspectives.

15622.synopsis:
In 2019, an outbreak of zombie virus quickly swept the world within months.
Communications were interrupted, water and electricity support ceased, chemical plant leaked, nuclear power plant exploded, the world was reduced to be like hell on earth; without God, it became an era of legends and saviors, with the fire of survival instinct rekindled within mortals.
Resident Evil zombie-theme in ABO setting.
“When the Lord Jesus comes for the second time, those  who died in Christ’s name will be raised from the grave first.”
– “1 Thessalonians 4:16”
associated_names: Undead พันธะรักวันสิ้นโลก

15878.synopsis:
When she woke up, she had already jumped through time and space. Qiao Wei fell silent. How could she be so unlucky? Sleeping can also cause time travel? Not just simple time travel, but becoming the mother of the two small buns.
But looking at the small buns’ sparkling little eyes, Qiao Wei could not say a word of complaint.
Bad! How could she handle such a situation? She had never been a mother! Could anything be worse than this?
Well then, time to make a plan. Raise the buns, get a fortune, and become prosperous.
If someone is not being evil, I will leave them untouched. If people respect me, I will also respect them, but if people make trouble for me, I will punish them, no matter what.
Xinglin spring, even if she was an abandoned woman, she could make a beautiful life too.
“Nān Nān, finally aunt found you! How could you leave that year? Aunt was looking for you like crazy! You still being alive is really good, let’s go home with aunt! A woman earning so much money is very unsafe outside!” Said a beautiful woman with a veil.
“You do not care about my children but want to touch my money. You know what, Aunt, it really hurts me!” Qiao Wei looked cold.
The little buns looked back and forth between their mother and a cold-looking man: “Mother, Uncle said he is my father.”
Qiao Wei smiled: “Good son, tell your father to prove his identity. What should be done?
Small buns opened a gold booklet and started reading one by one: “101 Qiao Family Rules”, insulting an underage girl, will be given palace punishment. “Uncle, if you are really our father … …”
After winning over the little buns, the man grabbed Qiao Wei’s chin with a long finger, showing a touch of a cold and dangerous smile: “If this Lord remembers right, it seems that night you were the one being hard on this Lord!”
associated_names: Marquis’s Abandoned Daughter: The Demon Prime Minister Reaches Out
侯门弃女：妖孽丞相赖上门

17158.synopsis:
Have you already died? Thus who can tell me…how high are the heavens? When can I break through the universe?
Originally, as the youngest disciple in Tianhe Mountain, Song Ning had lived with ease and been loved by his kind master. However, a dream brought his sect a massacre. He survived. From then on, destiny, love, conspiracy, death, cultivation…were interwoven with each other in his life.

17414.synopsis:
Ray Orlost, a boy who lived a blessed and happy life is devastated when his fiancées are stolen by the newly awakened hero.
He desperately tries to finish his life but at that moment⋯ ⋯.
He is visited by the goddess.
associated_names: Yuusha ni Heroine-tachi wo Torare, Suterareta Ore wo Megami-sama-tachi ga Hirotte Kuremashita
勇者にヒロイン達を取られ、捨てられた俺を女神様達が拾ってくれました

17926.synopsis:
Ichijou Jun is a high-school student. However, he is a loner and even on lunch break the only thing he does is studying. As a result of great effort, his test ranking rose and while he was satisfied with his loner life,
– Hi-hi-hi… virg*n, teach me agaain♪
– Shut up, b*tch. Let’s finish it quick today, OK?
– Yay!
One day, it was decided that he will help blonde gyaru Tachibana Karen, central figure of the class, with her studies. Loner during lunch break, tête-à-tête studying after school… So continues the double life.
Tsundere-like, but good at taking care of people Ichijou-kun.
A bit mischievous Tachibana-san with an innocent smile.
With this and that happening, the two get along so well that others cringe.
associated_names: Seishun Haisha Bocchi Yarou, Kinpatsu Shirigaru Gyaru no Okiniiri ni Naru
青春敗者ぼっち野郎、金髪尻軽ギャルのお気に入りになる

20742.synopsis: As a self-professed no-lifer, Yuri idles his days away in front of a computer. This all changes the moment his life in Japan comes to an abrupt end and he finds himself reborn in the strange new world of the Shiyalta Kingdom. His new life includes everything he once lacked: loving parents, a comfortable home, and a promising future breeding and raising birds on his dad’s ranch. For centuries, the kingdom he now calls home has enjoyed peace and prosperity, shielded by friendly nations that, like Shiyalta itself, were established with the collapse of a once-great empire. War is a distant problem, relevant only to Shiyalta’s ruling families whose warriors periodically set out to join the fighting upon massive birds trained by Yuri’s dad and others. But this peaceful existence can’t last forever. Something rotten lies at the heart of the kingdom, and it doesn’t take someone with Yuri’s exceptional intelligence to realize that those distant battles will only remain irrelevant for so long.
associated_names: Horobi no Kuni no Seifukusha - Maou wa Sekai wo Seifuku Suru You Desu (WN)
The Conqueror from a Dying Kingdom (WN)
亡びの国の征服者～魔王は世界を征服するようです～
亡國的征服者～魔王將征服世界～ (WN)

22022.synopsis:
In everyone’s heart dwells a demon.
She has a pen, carries an ethereal desire, and travels back and forth to different spaces.
Recording many “ghost” love affairs…
Heroine’s Monologue:
Bai Gui is my name but also the name of my pen. After collecting 100 ghosts, it will replace me to fulfill my thousand-year-old dream. With the ebb and flow of the secular world and the slow passing of time, I did not know how many times I had traveled back and forth between spaces, seen how many sorrowful partings and joyful reunions, or the old friends that I had gradually forgotten. I had no emotions but only that long-cherished wish in my heart that never changed…
—-
Using a “heroine” as the main connection,  This book is composed of multiple short stories. All stories do not obstruct the other.

23558.synopsis:
After suffering from a heat stroke while working under the scorching heat of summer, Lu Zhou, a hardworking but poor university student, somehow becomes the owner of an advanced technological system. With the cheat given by the system, his university life changes overnight.
A Master’s degree? Easy.
PhD? Not a problem.
From a nobody, he quickly becomes a huge celebrity in the world of science. With the missions given by the system, he is on his way to winning a Nobel Prize.
“System, can points be exchanged for money?”
“No.”
“F**k, what use are you then!?”
“This system will make you the ultimate scholar, the kind that lords over all of humanity. What use will money be to you?”

25350.synopsis:
Crow was about to graduate from the Royal Military Academy.
One day, he heard a voice from the Saintly Sword that could only be wielded by the chosen Hero——
The Holy Sword── Excalibur spoke to him!
The voice came from Holly, the Sprite of the Holy Sword.
The Demon King that wanted to destroy the world would be reviving soon, so they had to find the Hero quickly, and hand the Holy sword to the Hero.
Crow thought that delivering the sword to the Hero was a simple task, and will allow him to receive the merit of finding the messiah. He agreed readily, and went on a journey to find the Hero.
However, when the problem child Crow partnered with Holly who had a horrible personality, their journey was filled with disasters! And the Hero they found was actually a s*ave girl—?
How were they going to bring her back…?
“Why don’t you use me to cleave the master of that kid in half?”
associated_names: ポンコツ勇者の下剋上

25606.synopsis: Hae-in died from a sudden accident, except her death was due to an angel of death’s mistake. Now she must live in the body of a black cat while the angel of death rebuilds her body. Meanwhile, she lives with a friendly owner and a dangerous vet. It’s a battle to live as a cat–and to date as one as well.

25862.synopsis:
Shen Dongqing was a powerful, thousand-year-old ferocious ghost. He had just possessed a body and barely managed to relax for two days when he was pulled into a world where hundreds of ghosts were running amok.
On the first day of being pulled into the Infinite Nightmare Game:
Other players were trembling, crying and wailing about wanting to go home.
Shen Dongqing was eating, sleeping, and playing Fight the Landlord (card game).
The second day:
Other players were covering their heads and scurrying away like frightened rats as they were being chased by ghosts, and they were crying out loud for help.
Shen Dongqing was eating, sleeping and playing Fight the Landlord.
The third day.
Shen Dongqing……
The ghosts finally set their sights on this lazy player. The other players were finding joy in his misfortune, but in the end, no one had expected that the slim and pale Shen Dongqing would throw down his phone and directly dispatch the ghosts with his bare hands.
Other ghosts: Can’t afford to mess with him, move, move.

26630.synopsis:
Her family members died, one by one, and then a war erupted across the empire. Calliope never seemed to be able to escape death. But.
“Waaah!”
Wa….ah?! I’m crying? She had gone back to the time she had been born!
And so, to prevent the tragedy of her past life…she’ll develop fine motor skills!
*baby bends her fingers!*
and change the laws of nature!
*baby flips over for the first time!*
and to improve her communication prowess, she’ll diligently practice!
*baby says “Ga-ga-ga-ga” (though she tried to say A-B-C-D).*
She was so happy while spending time with her family and wanted to tell them she loved them…but after awhile…why is it that her family members seem to be doting on her way too much…? Calliope spends happy days with a family that squeals “how cute” at the mere sight of her breathing. Slowly, but surely, she’ll change the future.
But as she grows up and nears the time of reckoning…will she be able to prevent her family’s downfall, even at the cost of her body and life?

27398.synopsis: Short story depicting the backstory of the dwarf princess Françoise, who would eventually encounter and befriend Yurushia, the golden devil princess.
associated_names: 悪魔公女の童話 【 マ法幼女　モチプルン 】

30470.synopsis:
“If you had even an E-rank or F-rank skill, history would have been different.”
Jung Siwoo, a hero who had everything but ability.
Then the world granted him infinite abilities.
associated_names: After Returning, My Abilities are Infinite

32006.synopsis: A mediocre, low-born beggar, he relied on only his firm and indomitable spirit to desperately cultivate but still could not exceed the masses. Then by fortune’s favor, he awakened a long-extinct ancient martial soul. Since that day, he soared like a comet on the path of cultivation. From his humble beginnings as an outsider in the Ling Clan, his name, Ling Xiao, would ring throughout the world.

32774.synopsis:
Another world where god slayers gather. And there, one hero appears… Ren and his friends have won the decisive battle where Athena threatened to destroy the Earth. While their wounds from the battle have yet to heal, shocking news falls.
Something strange has happened in the heroic world of Hyperborea. The shadows of the “god slayers” are looming there. Ren and his friends’ unpredictable adventure begins…
At that time, one “god slayer” begins to move. It is Kusanagi Godou, known as the “Demon King” and a “god slayer” with many achievements to his name.
He too has heard about the strange happenings in the other world. His feet are heading to the other world. Will he meet Ren and his friends…?
And a new hero rises up to put an end to the abnormal situation in the other world!
The curtains rise on a new battle and adventure for the god slayers in the heroic world of Hyperborea! — Dash-X Bunko synopsis
associated_names: カンピオーネ！　ロード・オブ・レルムズ

35334.synopsis:
On that year, he was returning to civilian’s life. Stepping his foot into a vessel, embarking for Jiangnan.
In regards to the yearnings for women of the army chiefs from the barracks, if one were to summarize it in a sentence: The beauties in Jiangnan had long since gone.
Afterwards, he was made perplexed by that valiant and formidable looking female brigand, who dallied with women better than any man: Since when did the beauties in Jiangnan transform into such troublemakers?
This is a story of a shipping group’s female young leader wearing men’s clothes VS. an old-fashioned guy who had shed his armor to return to civilian’s life.

35590.synopsis:
There are beings who have been determined to be the strongest from birth.
His innate talent has reduced the efforts of those around him to nothing, and his hard-working genius is unrivaled.
He is an unidentified S-class adventurer wearing a mask. He is the youngest S-class adventurer in history, and his mastery of thunder magic is so impressive that his nickname is “Thunder Emperor”. He is known as the strongest magician in the world of adventurers.
His true identity is Noah Akright, a boy who lives in the forest with a witch.
Noah was picked up by the forest witch Shelah when he was a child.
Shelah noticed Noah’s extraordinary magical talent and gave Noah a gifted education in magic.
At the age of 15, he became the youngest ever to become an S-class adventurer.
With the alias “Van” and a mask of protective magic, Noah’s status as an adventurer was unassailable.
The day Noah became the youngest adventurer ever to be promoted to S-class adventurer, Sheila said to Noah, that he has another task.
”It’s your next assignment. The adventurer phase of hiding your identity and gaining power is over. Next, go to the magic academy and flaunt it to your heart’s content.”
Thus, in order to accomplish Shelah’s task, S-class adventurer Noah Akright, a.k.a. “Thunder Emperor” Van, is enrolled in the King’s Capital’s elite academy of magic – the Regulus School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
Fortunately or unfortunately for the other magic academy students, ……
They can also lightly rebel against discrimination from the nobility, and they are also able to lightly rebel against pressure from senior students, and in the end, they can lightly crush the evil organization.
This is the story of Noah, the strongest sorcerer of the lightning system, demonstrating his power without regret and achieving various legends in the magic academy.
The strongest sorcerer who does not know how to add to or subtract from his power is a warrior with his overwhelming power.
associated_names: 雷帝と呼ばれた世界最強のS級冒険者、一切遠慮することなくその力を遺憾なく発揮し魔術学院で無双してしまう
雷帝と呼ばれた最強冒険者、魔術学院に入学して一切の遠慮なく無双する

38150.synopsis:
[As you probably already know, I’m leaving you this letter only to keep my promise.]
Elisha, the Archmage of the Cardion Empire, and the fiancee of Emperor Erich wrote.
[The prince-no, Your Majesty, always said, “I’d rather die than marry you!”]
One day, she suddenly disappears, leaving only a letter to her fiance.
But contrary to what Elisha expected that he wouldn’t try to find her,  Erich immediately starts looking for her.
“Whether it’s inside or outside of the Empire, find her.”
When you find her and bring her back to me, then…
“We’ll make a new promise.”
***
“Your Majesty.”
Whatever the reason, Elisha couldn’t let Erich find her, but soon after, she found herself straining against the grip on her hand. 
“Please.”
Erich shook his head and opened his mouth again. The hand that was holding Elisha’s wrist went down and took her hand.
“Don’t leave.”

39430.synopsis:
In my seventeenth summer, three months before I went into isolation, the first daughter of Marquis Leonard, my “sister” returned, having disappeared shortly after birth.
Everyone in the mansion loved her, and only her. 
It didn’t matter.
Because from the very beginning, I’d known that my parents were utter tr*sh.
I would’ve helped and organized all the documents for land management, but I saw no point in bothering the family that would soon fall. 
A family that would fall, should I, the one who actually did all the work instead of the Marquis, disappear.
So, all I need to do is to isolate myself and get away from this place…
–It was extremely cold! It must’ve been a long time ago.
A self-proclaimed junior spirit I encounter ever so often, tells surprising stories.
“Then who will protect you?”
My ‘sister’, no, that woman, tried to ‘protect me’ under the guise of being a real sister. 
“What do you think, young Lady? If it’s this much of a loan, wouldn’t it be useful? Go ahead and run before someone snatches it away.”
The wily duke, who’d signed a mutual deal with me, would be entitled to a loss.
And…
“I’ve prayed to God, whom I’ve never prayed to before.”
When I saw my sweet childhood friend, who said just that, it seemed that in the end, we would no longer be just friends.

41478.synopsis:
Levicia, the fifteenth princess of the Crayden Empire, spends two weeks unconscious—only to awaken with memories of her previous life. In that vision, she realizes a terrifying truth: this world is nothing more than the setting of a book. Worse, she remembers her own fate within its pages—doomed to die, entangled in the bloody struggle of Crayden’s heirs.
Determined to quietly escape the palace before that destiny can claim her, Levicia steels her resolve.
But then—
“You carry the scent of a pure forest.”
“You called me.”
“Why didn’t you come today?”
The very successors destined to unleash a storm of blood across the empire begin showing interest in her. And that was only the beginning of her trials.
One day, by accident, Levicia steps into her attendant Pel’s room… and makes a shocking discovery. A wig. Underneath—raven-dark hair, and eyes like molten gold.
What madness is this? He’s the very protagonist who, in the future, will raze this empire to the ground.
“So you really mean it? That you’ve got nothing to say to me?”
“…”
“Now you avoid my eyes.”
“I’m reading.”
“…You’re nervous, too.”
“—!”
“This isn’t why we drew up that contract.”
Can Levicia truly slip away from the palace without being caught in the storm?

43014.synopsis:
Ling An married into the Xing family, became the second wife of Young Master Xing, he thought from then on to live a good life, but did not think, that he would spend his days like years. His heart and soul hollow to the end.
“Xing Shao, you gave me marriage but you tied me up, you are not willing to consider other people’s feelings, you are to the end ignoring me.”
That night, Xing Gexuan handed him a divorce agreement and said, “You’ve wanted to escape every day, now, I’m not stopping you, sign and go.”
He stamped, this moment, but Ling An did not have a trace of reluctance, no words, but nodded, agreed to him, but the tears have been uncontrollable.
Because he knows that the man he loves the most, is Xing Gexuan, even if the wound is full of holes, he will still be heartbroken.
Pulling the suitcase, the sky still dark, Ling An left.
But no one expected, an hour later, Xing Gexuan tore up the divorce certificate and feverishly started looking for him all over the world.

88070.synopsis:

On the day she heard the moving sermon of Nicholas Reinhart, the high priest she had been secretly in love with for a long time,
Rarien decided. Before she dies, she will definitely f*ck that perfect son of God.
* * *
“If a person has committed a sin, they should rightfully pay the price.”
“W-What do you mean?”
“You know. What I’m talking about.”
They say the devil originally smiles like an angel. Nicholas smiled more saintly than anyone while cornering Rarien into a dead end.
“Rarien Claude. You dare to run away after corrupting me?”
As she reached the bed, and the mattress touched her calves, Rarien unknowingly lost strength in her legs and sat down on the bed.
“Now then.”
Her upper body gradually leaned backward. It was because Nicholas, who was pretending not to be himself, climbed on top of her body.
He looked down at her with relaxed eyes, like a predator admiring its captured prey.
“It’s time to receive your punishment.”

92166.synopsis:
Shiye is a beta who grew up surrounded by alphas on the athletics team, which made him deeply resent the serious alpha dominance of A-ism. He only wants to spend his life with an omega who shares his ideals.
On a sunny afternoon, he fell head over heels for his good friend Jiang Chicheng’s twin sister. She is an omega.
After signing a series of unequal agreements, Jiang Chicheng finally agreed to help him pursue the omega.
The sister is perfect in every way, except for her overly strong possessiveness.
Whenever he glances at any omega during their dates, she gets so angry that she doesn’t reply for three days. If a teammate helps him get home when he’s drunk, she forces him to block the teammate in a fit of anger.
Every night after they move in together, she insists on biting the back of his neck, repeatedly marking him with her pheromones.
This has severely affected his normal social life.
Shiye tries to correct her, but she cries with red eyes, kisses his lips softly, and says, “Hubby, I’m sorry; I just care too much about you…”
Shiye is completely enchanted, unable to extricate himself. What bad intentions could an omega have? She simply cares too much for him!
—
The news of the Saifen Group’s young prince being kidnapped at the age of three once caused a sensation throughout City A.
His adoptive mother is blind, and the delicate and picky young prince didn’t get enough food or warm clothing in his new home. By the time he started elementary school, he still couldn’t button his clothes and was bullied everywhere.
Only Shiye took him home, caring for him like a stray kitten or puppy, g*ooming him, feeding him, and giving him baths.
Jiang Chicheng has always been good at pretending. He knows Shiye likes omegas, so he deliberately skips meals, starving himself to become thin and small, and calls him “brother” softly in his ear. He knows Shiye hates alphas, so after he evolves into a top alpha, he hides his voyeuristic and possessive desires, secretly leaving his pheromones on Shiye’s clothes under the guise of brotherhood.
Until one day, Shiye said he had fallen in love at first sight with Jiang Chicheng’s older sister. His sister, Jiang Chizao, is a fake omega who is truly an alpha.
On the night of their explosive argument, Jiang Chicheng looked at the corner of his mouth, bruised from being punched, and couldn’t help but laugh in anger. They are all alphas. If Jiang Chizao can pretend, why can’t he?

93190.synopsis:
I died and was reincarnated into a hardcore BL novel written by a friend. I was reborn as Ishar, the Emperor of the Luchest Empire, an extra character who works tirelessly every day for ten years, only to be killed by the main character, Belroan, and have the throne taken from him.
After four years of nonstop hard work, covering for an older brother who only caused trouble and then died, I finally realized the situation and made a decision.
“The only way to achieve my retirement…!”
If I can persuade the main character, who hasn’t yet lost his mind, to take over the throne, I’ll be able to escape this work hell and enjoy a peaceful retirement. I brought Belroan, who needed help, to the palace, took him as my disciple, and looked after him carefully. But what’s going on?
“I want to stay with you, Master.”
I taught him diligently, but somehow… this guy seems a bit… off.
– – –
“I believe it’s time for you to keep the promise you made when I became your disciple.”
The promise to give Belroan the throne. Of course, of course, I should hand over the throne. Now that he’s grown so splendidly, I was ready to give up the throne as soon as we returned.
“Didn’t you say that on the day I surpass you, you would accept me as your Empress?”
Ishar, who had been nodding along, suddenly froze. In that moment, Belroan gently released the gag and continued speaking.
“I’m very happy to become your partner.”
His voice, unable to conceal his joy, trembled softly with delight. Ishar spat out what had been blocking his mouth, then looked at Belroan with a tingling expression on his face.

93958.synopsis:
The witch Kalynia hid her identity and approached Snow White’s grandson.
All of this was for the revenge of the great witch who was defeated by Snow White, and for the grand plan of stealing the magic mirror!
To achieve this, she needed to get close to the grandson, King Vylon, who knew where the mirror was kept.
“In truth, the mirror was just an excuse to come to Your Majesty’s chambers. Are you angry?”
“…No. You’re quite a bold princess.”
Good. Vylon has completely fallen for it! Now, just a quick prick of this sedative needle, and in ten seconds…
“Look at me.”
Just wait a moment…
“If you dared to tempt me so boldly, I assume you’re prepared for the consequences?”
Why wasn’t he collapsing from the sedative? If this goes on, she’ll be in real trouble!

Oh, how did a simple plan to steal a mirror turned into this nightmare?!

94726.synopsis:
“The place where deep affection couldn’t reach had long been entered by someone driving a Maybach.”
After realizing he was just a backup option, Xia Tian hardened his heart and stopped believing in love, focusing solely on making money.
When he finally achieved success in his career, he discovered the person who had donated their cornea to him years ago.
Opening the donation report and the still-preserved diary, he read:
“The moon is bright, but its brightness is useless, yet it still shines. I like you, even though it’s pointless, but I still like you.”
“Goodbye, Xia Tian! Perhaps meeting you used up all my luck.”
At this moment, tears streamed down Xia Tian’s face.
It turned out, that girl had loved him for her entire youth!
Reborn into a new life, he swore to tightly hold onto his one true love, the girl who was like his eternal moonlight!
The school belle looked at him with a face full of grievance, “Xia Tian, you jerk! You’ve been getting so close to other girls—what about the three years you spent chasing me?”
“Consider it my bad luck.”
“Are you mad that I didn’t say yes to being with you? After graduation, I’ll give you a chance, okay?”
“No thanks. You deserve someone better, not someone like me, who used to be your best option.”
“Then what about these past few days when I’ve been trying so hard to win you back?”
“Consider it you not realizing your place, and me realizing mine!”
Xia Tian brushed off the school belle’s hand and turned to leave. He’s been reborn—whoever wants to be a lovesick fool can go ahead!
All he wanted now was to hold onto his sweet, soft, and tender moonlight!

– Ding! His devoted followers presented the Book of Wisdom. He gained omniscience.
– Ding! His loyal believers offered the Gravity Sphere. He acquired mastery over infinite gravity.
– Ding! His faithful presented the Thunder God’s Hammer. He wielded supreme lightning power.
As centuries passed, Xia Chuan ascended to the pinnacle of divinity, reigning supreme as the ultimate god. His name echoed across countless worlds, and trillions of devotees knelt in awe before his boundless might.

98822.synopsis:
“I want a blind woman to be the Crown Prince’s bedchambermaid.”

He will not cast you out.

100102.synopsis:
Lin Xiang, with her fair skin, stunning beauty, and charming liveliness, wakes up to find herself transmigrated into a period novel as the doomed, tragic cannon fodder supporting character.
According to the plot, due to her biased father and stepmother favoring sons over daughters, she is deceived into giving up her city job for her brother. Later, because of her extraordinary beauty, she catches the eye of the factory director’s abusive son, and her stepmother schemes to marry her off to him. Her life is destined to be miserable.

The transmigrated Lin Xiang resolves to lie flat and give up resisting. However, with wolves ahead and tigers behind, lying flat is impossible—she doesn’t even have a cheat skill or a wealthy benefactor to rely on!
Until…
Her childhood fiancé’s photo appears before her. The man in the photo has sharp eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a handsome, rugged face. With broad shoulders, a narrow waist, and a promising future, he’s already achieved remarkable military accomplishments at a young age. Devoted to his career, he doesn’t like coming home. Not to mention, his island post is rich in natural resources, offering sunshine, beaches, clams, shrimp, crabs, and sea fish galore.

118790.synopsis:
They say a cat’s life is the best life.

One day, I woke up as a cat.
All I ever did was get thrown into a dusty, filthy storage room, starve, get beaten with a broom, or get used as a toy for someone’s affection games.
No way I’m living in a dump like this!
Strawberry (what kind of name is that, you jerk landlord?) decided to run away from home. But when you leave home, it’s not just a dog’s life—it’s a cat’s hell.
After being chased around and bullied by territorial strays, Strawberry was miraculously rescued by a man.

《Appreciation Guide: About Me and Those Non-Human Race Girls》.

149254.synopsis:
